title: Polar distance bound: |x − a| ≤ ||x| − 1| + |angle| + η + η²
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P with Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2, a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a, e⟩ = 0, and π := Q.starProjection (the orthogonal projection onto Q). Then for every x ∈ ℝ^P with ⟨x, a⟩ > 0, writing η := |x − πx|/|x|, we have |x − a| ≤ ||x| − 1| + |arctan(⟨x, e⟩/⟨x, a⟩)| + η + η².
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → ∀ x : Euclid P, 0 < inner ℝ x a → dist x a ≤ |‖x‖ - 1| + |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| + ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ / ‖x‖ + (‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ / ‖x‖) ^ 2
